deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.approveBody: The run waits in Needs you; you review it and merge.
deliver.autoBody: Merges into the base branch when every step passed and Check passed on the merged result.
deliver.pullRequestBody: Opens a pull request instead of merging.
deliver.mergeCommitHint: The base branch gets a merge commit; the run's commits stay as they are.
deliver.squashTitle: The task's key and title, e.g. KON-16: Rate-limit messages
deliver.squashBody: Body: a short summary of the work and the run's number
deliver.integratorHint: Integrate runs with this profile when syncing with the base branch conflicts.
deliver.integratorUnknown: Fix the pipeline's steps first: the profiles that can resolve conflicts come from them.
deliver.noIntegrator: No step of this pipeline can change files, so conflicts go to you.
deliver.unknownProfile: A profile not in the project
deliver.recheck: Re-run Check on the merged result
deliver.recheckHint: Runs {{tools}} again after syncing with the base branch. A run never merges on a check of an older base.
deliver.recheckNoTools: The pipeline has no command tool step to run again on the merged result.
deliver.recheckOff: Off: a run merges once it is synced with the base, without checking the merged result again.
deliver.recheckLocked: Always on for Auto-merge: nothing merges without a passing check on the merged result.
deliver.addLine: Runs end in Ready for review and you merge them from the task.

leave.title: Discard the unsaved changes to {{name}}?
leave.what: Opening anything else now puts {{name}} back as it was saved. Keep editing and press Save to keep the changes.
leave.savingWhat: Wait for the save to finish, then press again. Nothing is discarded while it saves.
leave.whatClose: Closing the tab now puts {{name}} back as it was saved. Keep editing and press Save to keep the changes.
leave.whatOff: Opening anything else now puts {{name}} back as it was saved. Keep editing and fix what Save waits for to keep the changes.
leave.whatCloseOff: Closing the tab now puts {{name}} back as it was saved. Keep editing and fix what Save waits for to keep the changes.

settings.title: Pipeline
settings.failureSub: A step that stops without a result restarts once, then waits for your decision.

deliverOption.changesSub: Its commits are merged into the base branch.
deliverOption.reportSub: Its last step's report is the result; no repository changes are expected.
deliverOption.outsideSub: Done through MCP tools, e.g. a design or tickets: its report and the tool calls that changed something.
deliverOption.changesOrReportSub: Its commits are merged when it makes any; otherwise its report is the result.

branches.title: These steps can't be drawn as one line
branches.detail: A step waits for only part of what runs before it, so no single line shows their order. Edit the steps to see and change what each one waits for.

broken.title: These steps have no order to draw
broken.detail: The steps wait for each other in a circle, or for a step that is not there. Edit the steps to fix what they wait for.

states.newUnavailable: The pipelines can't be read yet, so there is nothing to add to.

all.title: No pipelines yet
all.detail: A pipeline is the steps a task's run goes through: who plans, who builds, who checks, and how it merges.

archived.title: Nothing archived
archived.detail: An archived pipeline leaves the lists and New task's picker, and the runs that use it stop.
